added.title: Director, Engineering-(Onsite) Overland Park, KS
added.description:
Build technology that helps move healthcare forward.

Netsmart is seeking a Director, Engineering Development to lead software engineering teams focused on building scalable, reliable, and high-quality technology solutions that support our healthcare platform and the clients we serve.

About Netsmart

Netsmart is a leading healthcare technology organization dedicated to Moving Healthcare Forward, Together. For more than 55 years, Netsmart has partnered with community-based and post-acute care providers to improve outcomes for the individuals and communities they serve.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Director, Engineering Development to lead software engineering teams focused on enterprise software delivery, platform scalability, technical excellence, and strong execution. This is an onsite leadership role based in Overland Park, KS.

This role is ideal for an engineering leader who grew up through software development, technical leadership, or architecture and brings credibility with engineering teams because they understand how modern software is designed, built, shipped, and supported.

The right leader will bring a strong development foundation, the ability to guide architecture and delivery decisions, and experience working with distributed teams, including teams in India. This leader will balance technical depth with people leadership, delivery discipline, and cross-functional partnership.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership & Delivery

Lead software engineering teams responsible for building, enhancing, and supporting enterprise healthcare technology solutions
Drive execution across software quality, performance, security, reliability, scalability, and operational readiness
Translate product and business priorities into engineering roadmaps, delivery plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes
Create clarity around priorities, ownership, decision-making, dependencies, and delivery expectations
Ensure teams are delivering high-quality software through disciplined Agile practices and structured execution
Partner with leaders across engineering, product, architecture, and operations to remove obstacles and improve delivery flow

Technical & Architecture Leadership

Provide technical leadership across application development, architecture, integrations, APIs, cloud-based systems, and platform modernization
Guide architecture and engineering tradeoffs using practical, hands-on knowledge of software development
Partner with architects and senior engineers to establish reusable patterns, technical standards, design practices, and code quality expectations
Promote scalable, maintainable, and sustainable engineering practices across teams
Help teams modernize platforms, reduce technical debt, and improve system performance and reliability
Bring credibility to technical conversations through a background in engineering, architecture, or hands-on software delivery

Global Team Leadership

Lead and collaborate with distributed engineering teams, including teams based in India
Build strong working relationships across geographies, time zones, and cultures
Create consistent expectations for delivery, communication, accountability, and engineering standards across global teams
Partner effectively with offshore and onsite leaders to ensure alignment, execution, and team engagement
Support a collaborative operating model that enables teams to move efficiently while maintaining quality and clarity

People Leadership & Talent Development

Lead, coach, and develop high-performing engineering teams and engineering leaders
Mentor managers, technical leads, architects, and engineers to strengthen technical capability and leadership effectiveness
Build a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement
Recruit, retain, and grow technical talent aligned with Netsmart values, engineering standards, and delivery expectations
Help teams navigate complexity, prioritize effectively, and stay focused on business and client impact

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner closely with Product Management to deliver solutions aligned to client needs, market priorities, and business outcomes
Collaborate with Security, Compliance, Operations, Architecture, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are reliable, secure, and scalable
Communicate technical strategy, delivery progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional partners
Build trust with stakeholders through transparency, sound judgment, and consistent execution

Qualifications

Required

10+ years of software engineering, software development, or technology leadership experience
Proven experience leading engineering teams with increasing scope and accountability
Strong foundation as a software engineer, technical lead, architect, or engineering leader
Demonstrated ability to guide architecture, software design, engineering execution, and delivery strategy
Strong understanding of modern software development practices, Agile delivery, DevOps, APIs, integrations, cloud-based architectures, and distributed systems
Experience leading global or distributed engineering teams, including teams in India
Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed organization and partner across engineering, product, architecture, security, operations, and business teams
Strong communication, people leadership, technical judgment, execution discipline, and stakeholder management skills
Ability to work onsite in Overland Park, KS

Preferred

Healthcare technology experience
Experience working in regulated industries
Experience modernizing engineering practices, improving platform scalability, or establishing reusable architecture patterns
Experience leading teams through technical transformation, platform modernization, or enterprise software delivery
Background in software architecture, application development, or technical leadership within enterprise product environments

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means becoming a trusted engineering leader who can turn strategy into practical execution. You will help teams deliver scalable technology solutions, strengthen engineering discipline, and continue building a high-performing engineering culture.

You will be known for strong technical credibility, clear operating discipline, people leadership, and the ability to partner across the organization to deliver technology that supports clients, providers, and communities.

Why Netsmart

At Netsmart, you will build technology that truly matters. This role offers the opportunity to lead impactful engineering development work within a mission-driven organization where innovation supports clinicians, providers, organizations, and communities every day.

This is an opportunity for a proven engineering leader to join Netsmart onsite in Overland Park, KS and help lead the next chapter of software engineering excellence.

Netsmart Values in Action

Value

How This Leader Shows Up

Bold

Makes clear technical decisions, challenges assumptions, and helps teams move complex work forward.

Passionate

Cares deeply about engineering excellence, associate growth, and technology that supports healthcare impact.

Relentless

Drives accountability, delivery discipline, and continuous improvement through complexity.

Collaborative

Builds trust across engineering, product, architecture, operations, and global teams.

Netsmart is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer, providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all associates. All employment decisions at Netsmart, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, promotion and transfer, are based on performance, qualifications, abilities, education and experience. Netsmart does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, past or present military service, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

Netsmart desires to provide a healthy and safe workplace and, as a government contractor, Netsmart is committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace in accordance with applicable federal law. Pursuant to Netsmart policy, all post-offer candidates are required to successfully complete a pre-employment background check, including a drug screen, which is provided at Netsmart’s sole expense. In the event a candidate tests positive for a controlled substance, Netsmart will rescind the offer of employment unless the individual can provide proof of valid prescription to Netsmart’s third party screening provider.

If you are located in a state which grants you the right to receive information on salary range, pay scale, description of benefits or other compensation for this position, please use this form to request details which you may be legally entitled.

All applicants for employment must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Netsmart does not provide work visa sponsorship for this position.

added.title: Director, AI Platform
added.description:
Axial Search is a specialist executive search firm built for one kind of hire: leaders who help organizations navigate AI transformation. Apply today to express your interest in roles like this one.

Visit our website to learn more about our process and explore free tools for your job search, including our live job market dashboard with salary, skills and hiring trend data from thousands of AI transformation roles.

What The Market Looks Like

We've tracked 500+ senior-level postings in AI architecture across the US over the last six months, with strong demand in California, Texas, and New York—particularly in technology, financial services, and professional services. Compensation typically ranges from $250K to $430K annually. The strongest candidates bring hands-on experience architecting AI systems at scale, deep fluency in modern ML infrastructure and deployment patterns, and the ability to translate technical complexity into business value. These leaders often combine deep engineering judgment with the communication skills needed to partner across product, data, and operations teams.

Job Responsibilities

Own the technical strategy and roadmap for AI platform capabilities, balancing innovation with reliability and operational cost.
Design and evolve the architecture for model development, training, inference, and monitoring infrastructure to support multiple use cases across the organization.
Lead a team of AI/ML engineers, architects, and platform specialists—setting technical standards, conducting architecture reviews, and mentoring for growth.
Partner with product and business leaders to translate AI opportunities into technical requirements and feasible delivery plans.
Drive decisions on build vs. buy, open-source vs. proprietary, and cloud infrastructure choices—evaluating trade-offs in performance, cost, and time-to-market.
Establish observability, governance, and security practices for AI systems, including model versioning, explainability, bias detection, and compliance frameworks.
Collaborate with data engineering and data science teams to integrate feature pipelines, data quality checks, and retraining workflows into platform operations.

Candidate Requirements

10+ years of software engineering or ML systems experience, with at least 4–5 years in AI architecture, platform engineering, or leading ML infrastructure teams.
Demonstrable track record architecting and shipping production AI systems (large language models, computer vision, forecasting, recommender systems, or similar) at meaningful scale.
Deep hands-on knowledge of model serving frameworks, training infrastructure, vector databases, experiment tracking, and monitoring tools in modern ML stacks.
Proven ability to lead and grow engineering teams, set technical vision, and communicate trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong judgment on system design—experience with distributed systems, data pipelines, or cloud infrastructure decisions and their business implications.
Familiarity with governance, security, and compliance considerations in AI systems (model governance, bias mitigation, regulatory frameworks).

added.title: Director of Engineering, Solution Engineering and Support
added.description:
Who We Are

Claritas Rx uses AI and predictive modeling to help rare disease and specialty brands remove the barriers that keep patients from accessing and staying on the treatments they need. By uniting the most complete view of the patient journey with purpose-built technologies, we predict and resolve access challenges before they disrupt care, combining advanced analytics, real-world data, AI, and CRM capabilities to increase start and refill rates, reduce abandonment, and improve brand performance. Our mission is to ensure patients with chronic, life-threatening diseases receive the support that enables the greatest benefit from their therapy. Simply put, our promise is progress for every patient journey.

This is the opportunity to help shape a first-in-industry digital health solution alongside a team of mission-driven professionals. We were named one of Inc.'s Best Workplaces in 2025 and recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026), and our team genuinely respects and supports each other. We thrive on being fast-paced, innovative, and results-driven, and our employees enjoy a flexible, collaborative work environment, unlimited PTO, stock options, and a growing set of tools and technology to drive innovation for our customers.

The Position

We are a rapidly growing healthcare technology company seeking a Director of Engineering to lead Solution Engineering and Customer Support Operations within our Customer Engineering organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Customer Engineering, you will own our technical engagement with customers before and after implementation: shaping the right solution during the sales cycle, and ensuring stable, high-quality support once customers are live on the Ascend platform. You will partner closely with the Director of Implementations, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Platform Engineering, and you will build and lead a blended team of onshore employees and offshore contractor partners. Our platform ingests, validates, masters, and analyzes complex specialty pharmacy, hub, and payer data, turning it into actionable insights for biopharmaceutical manufacturers. This role is primarily remote with occasional travel requirements of up to 25%.

Key Accountabilities

Leadership And Operations

Build, lead, and develop a team of solution engineers, data engineers, and support engineers across onshore FTEs and offshore contractor partners, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development.
Define team charters, operating models, and clear handoffs with Implementations (pre-sales to kickoff, and go-live to support) so customers experience one continuous Customer Engineering team.
Establish and report on metrics for both functions, such as SLA attainment, ticket volume and aging, incident trends, estimate accuracy, and solution win rates.
Own capacity planning, contractor vendor relationships, and budget for the teams in scope.

Solution Engineering

Serve as the technical lead in pre-sales: lead discovery, solution design, technical demos, and responses to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires.
Translate customer business requirements into solution designs that fit the standard Ascend offering, and identify where paid add-on services or custom extracts are needed.
Review SOWs and level-of-effort estimates for technical accuracy, scope, and delivery risk before they are signed.
Own the system architecture view for each customer engagement, covering data sources, ingestion, integrations, and outbound extracts.
Disposition product gaps surfaced during the sales cycle, routing them to Product with clear business context and customer impact.
Ensure a clean technical handoff to Implementations at kickoff, including documented scope, assumptions, and data source inventory.

Customer Support Operations

Own post-go-live technical support for customers on the Ascend platform, including production support, issue triage, root cause analysis, and resolution.
Lead KTLO and sustainment for existing Ascend customers, and drive ongoing optimization to reduce cost and effort.
Build and scale the Ascend support model as new and existing customers go live, including runbooks, coverage, escalation paths, and SLAs.
Partner with Infrastructure and Platform Engineering on environment health, monitoring, data pipeline reliability, and access management.
Manage intake, prioritization, and delivery of customer enhancement requests and ongoing reporting needs.
Identify recurring issues and partner with Product and Engineering on permanent fixes that reduce support load.
Act as the escalation point for critical incidents and data quality issues, communicating clearly with customer and internal stakeholders.

Who You Are

Skills/Knowledge

Proven people leader who has built and scaled teams, including distributed teams with offshore contractor partners.
Strong hands-on background in data engineering and data platforms: ETL/ELT pipelines, SQL, data modeling, and data quality.
Experience with AWS data and infrastructure services (such as S3, Glue, Lambda, and Redshift or Snowflake) and orchestration tools such as Airflow.
Able to explain complex technical concepts to business stakeholders and executives, and to represent Claritas Rx credibly in front of customers.
Experience defining SLAs, support processes, and ticketing workflows (such as Jira Service Management), and using metrics to run the function.
Entrepreneurial and resourceful: we need people who can find creative ways to make a big impact quickly and without much direction.

Requirements

BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or another STEM related field
12+ years of experience in software or data engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams
Experience leading both a customer-facing technical team (solution engineering, sales engineering, or professional services) and a technical support or production operations team

Preferred Skills

SaaS experience in a similar customer-facing role, such as solutions engineering or professional services, ideally at a growth stage or start-up company. Or a consulting background in client-facing technical delivery, such as technology, data, or life sciences consulting.
Understanding of the life sciences commercial data ecosystem, including specialty pharmacy, hub, distributor, and payer data.
Experience supporting customers through a platform migration or major version upgrade.
Experience working with PHI in a HIPAA-regulated data environment.

Join Us

We are seeking to add new expertise and perspective to our strong team of experienced professionals. We aspire to a culture of accelerated professional development through: shared learning and collaboration; a respectful and fun work environment; and employee empowerment through the effective use of technology and tools.

We are a highly collaborative team and prioritize opportunities to connect in person. For employees within a reasonable driving distance of each other, we host regional town hall gatherings approximately every other month. These sessions give our teams a chance to come together, share updates, and strengthen relationships beyond day-to-day work.

In addition to our great environment, we offer a competitive salary of $195,000 to $220,000
and benefits package and the opportunity to make a significant impact on a first-in-industry digital health solution. Please send a cover letter along with your resume when applying to the position of interest. Claritas Rx embraces diversity, equality, and transparency. We are committed to building a team that comprises a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We believe the more inclusive we are, the better we are.

Join us and discover what it feels like to be part of an environment that rewards ingenuity, risk taking and smart work. It's time to fall in love with what you do!

At Claritas Rx, protecting our candidates is a top priority. If you're applying for a role with us, please note:

All legitimate opportunities are posted first on ClaritasRx.com. Check there before trusting external listings.
We believe in meaningful interviews: offers never come after just one phone call or form. Expect multiple video calls to get to know you.
We never ask for fees or payments of any kind during the hiring process.
Our People Operations Team will handle your onboarding, and all equipment comes directly from us—no purchases required.

Learn more about how to spot recruitment scams and protect yourself - FBI warning: https://bit.ly/4aDF5wU

Claritas Rx is committed to transparency, integrity, and a safe hiring experience for every candidate. Learn more
